During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Imperial convoy traffic in the [[Polith system]] came under attack by Republic-sponsored [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and mine-layers. As a result, the Empire dispatched the [[Empire's Fury]] squadron to '''destroy''' the pirates.
